description: Generic FTDI-class USB transport control dialect: the D2XX/libftdi common control surface (reset, timeouts, latency, baud, purge, bit mode, pin read) plus the generic section 8.1 stream kinds a device's command frames ride on. The contract carries no vendor device knowledge: opcodes, register maps and bitstreams stay in the plugins that pin this contract.

oneOf.description: FT_SetTimeouts in milliseconds; both bounds are nonnegative.
FT_SetLatencyTimer; the latency timer is one byte.
FT_SetBaudRate; the rate is a positive integer.
FT_SetBitMode: the pin-direction mask and the interface mode, each one byte.
FT_GetBitMode / ftdi_read_pins: read the bit-mode pin states. The result carries exactly one byte.

request_schema.description: One control transaction: the op discriminator plus that op's parameters, exactly as the pinning plugin's builders type them. The kind key itself is validated by the host before this schema applies; every property here other than the discriminator is a payload.

oneOf.description: Actuation ops (reset_device, set_timeouts, set_latency, set_baud, purge, set_bitmode): transport acceptance only, like stream_send; an empty result carries no device meaning.

read_pins: exactly one byte, carried as its padded base64 text (two payload characters plus '=='). Length four alone admits unpadded three-byte spellings like 'QUJD'; the pattern closes that door, so one byte means one byte. data is bytes at the adapter ABI and base64 text in contract documents and journals.

result_schema.description: Empty for actuation ops; one byte for read_pins.

host_requirements.summary: Host-side FTDI-class access to the commissioned device only: libftdi or D2XX semantics for the seven control calls. No filesystem paths, no process spawning, no network endpoints.

evidence.scope: Grammar of the FTDI common control surface as the pinning plugin's builders type it (protocol.py reset_device/set_timeouts/set_latency/set_baud/purge/set_bitmode/read_pins), recorded against one hardware session's exchanges over the generic section 8.1 stream kinds
limitations: Direct hardware exercise covers set_latency, set_baud, set_bitmode, read_pins and purge of the rx queue only; reset_device, set_timeouts and purge of the tx queue rest on the static-analysis record of the same session
The register and command decode above this transport (page-bit decomposition, register map) is outside this contract's evidence; the pinning plugin's decode remains its own claim
No sample-plane read was recorded on hardware; a journal carrying sample-plane rows cannot cite this approval as its evidence for them
